args.title: Find 2 referrable people on Razorpay's AI platform (LinkedIn)
args.brief:
Read-only LinkedIn task, one answer needed.

Goal: the owner (Raghvendra, Product Engineer I at Juspay, job hunting) wants two people at Razorpay who work on Razorpay's AI platform (their internal AI/LLM platform, GenAI, or AI engineering org — not the FDE-support track) and who could credibly refer him.

Steps:
1. Open the Razorpay company page on LinkedIn (linkedin.com/company/razorpay) and its People tab.
2. Search LinkedIn for current Razorpay employees with titles like AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Applied AI, GenAI, Platform (AI), Forward Deployed. Locations should be India (Bengaluru preferred).
3. For each plausible person, record: full name, current title/team at Razorpay, whether they are a 1st-degree connection of the owner (yes/no / degree shown), location, and one line of shared ground (Juspay/payments background, Bengaluru, school, past employer, mutual connections if visible).

Return: the two best candidates ranked, with a one-line reason each for why they could refer (e.g. direct connection vs 2nd-degree with shared employer). If none are 1st-degree, still return the best two with degree shown. Keep it under 15 lines. Do not open profiles of anyone outside Razorpay, do not send anything, do not connect — read-only.
